stepTitle: If Sam adds all three one-hot encoded features to his current model, a unique OLS solution will not exist.
stepBody:
Sam uses the following model to predict attendance rate:
$$\hat{y}=\hat{	heta}_0+\hat{	heta}_1x_1+\hat{	heta}_2x_2$$
where $$y$$ is attendance rate, $$x_1$$ is dist from bell and $$x_2$$ is section no.
Sam one-hot encoded weather into three new features. Evaluate the following statements.
